source_refs.note: 9- Glyoxysomes: a main subheading of 3.4 Structure of the cell, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 74-75.

blocks.text: Glyoxysomes peroxisomes jaise hain lekin sirf poday ke cells mein milte hain. In mein woh enzymes hain jo lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain. Yeh lipid (tel) se bharpoor beejon, jaise castor beans aur soyabeans, ke cells mein sab se zyada hote hain. Beej ugne (germination) ke waqt yeh jama shuda lipids ko carbohydrates mein badalte hain jo ugne ke liye energy dete hain.
